description:
Hoist the three uniform trait-selector defaults into module-level constants that the trait defaults name, carrying provenance citations across.

## Background

The proof-surface seam design (dev/active/7d7c647c/design.md) governs this task; read it in full. Its §3 fixes the three-part seam with probe-verified surface claims, §4 gives each field its name, kind, range, default-naming constant, mechanism and route-observation obligation, §5 records the decisions (D1 direct removal, D2 lane split, D3 opaque pin, D4 default naming, D5 public reporters, D6 source-level convention amendments), §6 enumerates the post-processing deletions, and §8 scopes the tasks. The follow-on migration design (dev/active/7d824b2f/design.md) supplies the shared field-kind, mechanism and test conventions.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: WINOGRAD_MIN_DIM_DEFAULT, TRI_BASE_MAX_DIM_DEFAULT and PLE_SCALAR_BASE_MAX_COLS_DEFAULT exist as module-level pub(crate) constants in field/winograd.rs, field/triangular.rs and field/ple.rs, each carrying the measured-provenance rustdoc of seam design §4.4, and each trait default names its hoisted constant instead of restating the literal.
- [hard] REQ-02: The three stale archive receipt paths the seam design §4.4 names are repaired.
- [hard] REQ-03: The trait still declares all four constants and every read site still reads them; behaviour and the extraction surface are unchanged (the seam design's probe S4/AS4 verifies this state).
title: Hoist the uniform trait-selector defaults into their modules
